semiconductor_relevance: High — MKP Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of Mass Flow Controllers, which are critical components in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: MKP Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) in Korea, providing comprehensive solutions for precise mass flow measurement and control in semiconductor fabrication. The company focuses on innovation and R&D to deliver customized solutions that enhance efficiency and reliability in critical processes.

regional_presence.Korea: MKP Co., Ltd. is the first and only company in Korea to develop and manufacture Mass Flow Controllers, significantly impacting the local semiconductor market.
